Job Description:
AI Talent is seeking a skilled Business Analyst to join our team. In this role, you will collaborate closely with stakeholders to identify and gather system requirements, develop system plans and supporting documentation, assess and improve existing systems, and design tailored solutions that align with business objectives.

Responsibilities:
Work closely with users and business units to identify business/operational pain points, elicit and analyse requirements, investigate and assess business/operating procedures, and collaborate with the team to provide solutions
Formulate and document business requirements based on the analysis of current business processes and procedures
Act as a central reference between business and technology units to facilitate business-IT alignment and support the data-driven decision-making process
Collaborate with stakeholders (developer/product manager/etc.) to identify and recommend software solutions
Develop detailed functional requirement specifications using epics and user stories
Work with UI designers to create and review UI designs that align with system specifications
Communicate software requirements to the development and QA teams during walkthroughs and planning sessions
Create clear system specifications through the use of use case diagrams, data/process modelling, flowcharts, or other UMLs for system development
Perform user acceptance testing to ensure the software is in line with requirements, meets quality standards, and plan deployment cycles
Conduct market research and system analysis to support third-party integrations
Identify gaps and inefficiencies, and suggest improvements to processes or system specifications
Work within an Agile team environment to implement best practices and deliverables on schedule and within budget
Create and maintain onboarding/training documentation and conduct training sessions for new team members or customers

Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, specialising in Business Analytics
Minimum 2 years of full-time experience working as a Business Analyst
Experience writing detailed, clear, and consistent functional requirement specifications using epics and user stories
Proven ability to prioritise business requirements effectively
Hands-on experience creating system specifications using UMLs
Experience working with REST APIs
Strong understanding of databases with the ability to write SQL queries
Knowledge of backend and frontend technologies
Understanding of responsive design and systems
Strong understanding of client-server architecture
Experience working within Agile – Scrum development methodology
Hands-on experience using JIRA, Confluence, and Azure DevOps
Demonstrated ability to take ownership of tasks and thrive in a dynamic team environment
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Proficient in using MS Visio for Business Process Modelling

Permanent Residents (PR) and Australian Citizens are eligible to apply
Job Type: Full-time
Salary: $70,000 to $120,000 per year + Super

About Dipole Group
We are a wholly Australian owned and operated ICT and Telecom networks specialist delivery business. Dipole operates locally, regionally, and internationally. Our capabilities span across Telecommunications, Finance, Insurance, health, Public Services, Print / Digital Media, Broadcast and Supply Chain. Dipole Group is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Database Specialist to join our team supporting telecommunications platforms and applications. The successful candidate will be responsible for the administration, monitoring, performance optimisation, security, and availability of enterprise database environments while ensuring compliance with service level agreements (SLAs) and operational standards.

Key Responsibilities

· Administer, maintain, and support enterprise database environments across production, development, testing, and disaster recovery platforms.

· Ensure database availability, performance, integrity, and security for mission-critical telecommunications applications.

· Perform proactive monitoring, performance tuning, capacity planning, and health checks.

· Manage database installations, upgrades, patching, migrations, and configuration changes.

· Support incident, problem, and change management activities in accordance with ITIL processes.

· Investigate and resolve database-related incidents within agreed SLA and KPI targets.

· Perform root cause analysis and implement preventive measures to minimize service disruptions.

· Manage database backup, recovery, replication, and disaster recovery processes.

· Support high availability and business continuity requirements for telecom services.

· Collaborate with application, infrastructure, network, and security teams to ensure optimal platform performance.

· Develop and maintain operational documentation, standard operating procedures, and technical runbooks.

· Participate in planned maintenance activities and on-call support rotations as required.

· Ensure compliance with security policies, governance standards, and operational procedures.

· Identify opportunities for automation and continuous service improvement.

Required Experience

· Minimum 3–5 years of experience in Database Administration or Database Support roles.

· Experience working within Managed Services, IT Operations, or Enterprise Support environments.

· Proven experience supporting large-scale, high-availability database platforms.

· Experience managing production environments with strict SLA and KPI requirements.

· Experience supporting telecommunications, service provider, or mission-critical enterprise environments is highly desirable.

Operational Support

· Problem Management

· Change Management

· Root Cause Analysis

· Disaster Recovery Planning and Testing

· Service Monitoring and Reporting

Scripting & Automation

· SQL

· Shell/Bash Scripting

· PowerShell

· Python (desirable)

Preferred Qualifications

· Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

· Oracle Certified Professional (OCP), Microsoft SQL Server Certification, or equivalent database certifications.

· ITIL Foundation certification preferred.

· Experience supporting Telecom OSS/BSS platforms, Billing Systems, CRM platforms, Subscriber Management Systems, or Network Management Systems is highly desirable.

· Experience working within 24x7 operational support environments.

Key Attributes

· Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

· Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.

· Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced Managed Services environment.

· Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to service excellence.

· Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining operational stability and service quality.

Geographic Information System (GIS) Analyst

Kogan People Solutions are delighted to be working with a local government powerhouse in Melbourne’s southeast, who wish to appoint a qualified skilled and experienced Geographic Information System (GIS) Analyst.

The newly appointed Geographic Information System (GIS) Analyst will coordinate the collection, maintenance, and reporting of Council’s GIS and spatial databases to ensure a "single source of truth" enhance spatial systems to support business units, optimize data integration for modelling, and deliver GIS training and support across the organization.

Location – Dandenong Vic

Employment Type: Full-time, Ongoing

Salary – Offered in the range $95k to $105k plus superannuation, per annum 

Key Responsibilities of this exciting position include

System Development & Management

•	Platform Administration: Manage and enhance QGIS, IntraMaps, Mapbox, and related spatial systems to expand corporate utility.

•	Integration: Integrate GIS with corporate databases, the Property Information System, and Asset Management Systems to ensure data quality and system functionality.

•	Data Governance: Coordinate spatial data collection (including GPS data) and ensure compliance with external data agreements.
Business Analysis & Reporting

•	Data Interrogation: Utilize GIS and SQL query tools to extract, analyze, and interrogate spatial data for ad-hoc business requirements.

•	Reporting & Presentation: Create, map, and professionally present spatial and textual information for performance reporting and publications.

Customer Support & Vendor Management

•	Support & Training: Provide technical support, document user requests, prepare training materials, and deliver non-technical GIS training to internal staff.

•	Collaboration: Facilitate the bi-monthly GIS User Group and maintain effective working relationships with software vendors and contractors.
Continuous Improvement & Governance

•	Process Optimization: Review GIS workflows via process mapping and assist in developing industry-best-practice policies and procedures.

•	Change Management: Adhere to operational procedures for IT services, focusing on system testing and change management principles.

To be considered, we expect to be able to observe:

Education and Professional Memberships

•	Degree Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Computer Science, or a relevant IT field.

•	Professional Association: Membership (or eligibility for membership) with a professional geospatial body requiring Continuing Professional Development (CPD), such as the Geospatial Council of Australia (formerly SSSI) or GITA.

Technical Skills & Experience

•	GIS & Database Admin: Proven experience developing, implementing, and administering GIS systems, SQL servers, and databases (Local Government experience preferred).

•	Data Querying: Demonstrated ability to interrogate complex spatial data using spatialized SQL queries.

•	Analytical & Communication Skills: Strong problem-solving capabilities, paired with the ability to communicate technical GIS concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Mandatory Licences & Pre-Employment Checks

The following credentials must be held (or obtained) prior to commencement and maintained throughout employment:

•	Current valid Victorian Driver’s Licence

•	Satisfactory National Police Check

•	Satisfactory Working with Children Check (WWCC)

Interested?

Please express interest to the recruiters Kogan People Solutions quoting reference # 6189-FS, using the facilities on this website.

We can only respond to shortlisted candidates and apologise in advance if we don’t respond to your application.

KOGAN PEOPLE SOLUTIONS – recruitment excellence
